about.title: About ExpoShare
about.intro: ExpoShare is a community library where students, researchers, educators and professionals share educational presentations.
about.legal_note: This page provides general information, not legal advice.
about.privacy_p1: ExpoShare collects the information you provide directly, such as your email address, profile details, and the presentations you upload. We also automatically collect basic usage data (like pages visited) needed to operate and secure the platform.
about.privacy_p2: We use your information to operate ExpoShare: creating your account, publishing approved presentations, sending you notifications about your submissions, and moderating content. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
about.privacy_p3: Your data is stored with Supabase and protected by Row Level Security, so only you (and platform administrators, where moderation requires it) can access your private information. Uploaded files are stored in access-controlled storage.
about.privacy_p4: You can review and update your profile at any time from your account settings. To request deletion of your account or data, contact us using the form on the Contact page.
about.privacy_p5: If we make material changes to this policy, we'll update this page. Continued use of ExpoShare after changes means you accept the updated policy.
about.terms_p1: By creating an account or using ExpoShare, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the platform.
about.terms_p2: You're responsible for the accuracy of your account information and for keeping your password secure. You must be legally permitted to use online services in your jurisdiction.
about.terms_p3: By uploading a presentation, you confirm you own it or have the right to share it, and you grant ExpoShare a non-exclusive license to host, display, and distribute it on the platform for as long as it remains published.
about.terms_p4: You may not upload content that infringes someone else's rights, is illegal, hateful, or misleading, or that you don't have permission to share. We may reject, request changes to, hide, or remove any submission that violates these terms.
about.terms_p5: ExpoShare is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We aren't liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform, to the maximum extent permitted by law.
about.terms_p6: We may update these terms from time to time. We'll post the revised terms here; continuing to use ExpoShare after changes means you accept them.
about.copyright_p1: Copyright concerns can be reported directly from any presentation page using the Report button, or through the contact form on the Contact page.
about.copyright_p2: If you believe your copyrighted work was uploaded without permission, tell us the presentation link, a description of the work, and your contact details using the contact form, and we'll review and remove infringing content promptly.
